logp.method_description: The log P values were determined using the shake flask method. Both octanol and water were presaturated with water or octanol, respectively. Due to the low stability of the compounds in water/ octanol mixture, the standard procedure was modified as follows: The sample compound was shaken intensively in a mixture of water and octanol for 2 h. Phase separation was achieved using a centrifuge (Sorvall, RT6000B) at 20 °C for 5 min at 3000 rpm. The compounds in the organic phase were quantified by using an UV-vis spectrophotometer (Perkin-Elmer, Lambda 7).
